verification_report.summary: The elementary current-duality supplement and all three specified downstream applications are correct under the stated accepted inputs. The zero-degree argument works in every n>=1; the threshold smooth-attainment characterization is valid; G_omega and C_omega have the claimed compactness, metrizability, and convexity properties; Hahn-Banach separation uses exactly the weak current topology and a smooth real (1,1)-form; the polar test correctly ranges over all smooth possibly nonclosed pseudoeffective backgrounds; and the Lipschitz and minimizer-stability conclusions follow from normalized trace control. The applications to zero variational-volume attainment, m_h<=kappa_h, and the exceptional curve are valid. No product of two nonsmooth currents or Monge-Ampere mass hypothesis is used.
